Cloud Application Tenant Resource Get Scan Info
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/casbTenant/scanInfo

Retrieves the SaaS Security Scan Configuration information. .

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page offset

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size

Default value: 500
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
tenantName
string

The SaaS application tenant name

tenantId
int32

The SaaS application tenant ID

saasApplication
string

The sanctioned SaaS application type

Possible values: [SLACK, MSTEAM, WEBEX, MSTEAM_GCC_HIGH, MSTEAM_DOD, MSTEAM_GCC_MOD, ZOOM, TRELLO, SALESFORCE, MSFT_DYNAMICS365, TWILIO, EXCHANGE, GMAIL, EXCHANGE_GCC_HIGH, EXCHANGE_DOD, EXCHANGE_GCC_MOD, BOX, ONEDRIVE, SHAREPOINT, DROPBOX, GOOGLEDRIVE, SHAREFILE, CONFLUENCE, EGNYTE, ONEDRIVE_GCC_HIGH, ONEDRIVE_DOD, SHAREPOINT_GCC_HIGH, SHAREPOINT_DOD, ONEDRIVE_GCC_MOD, SHAREPOINT_GCC_MOD, SMARTSHEET, CHATGPT, MSFTCOPILOT, SERVICENOW, JIRA, JUMPCLOUD, MS_ATP_DEFENDER, GSUITE, OFFICE365, MIP, OKTA, OFFICE365_GCC_HIGH, OFFICE365_DOD, OFFICE365_GCC_MOD, APPTOTAL, WORKDAY, DOCUSIGN, GITHUB, BITBUCKET, GITLAB, AWSS3, AZUREBLOB, GCPSTORAGE, AWSS3_SMIR, AZUREBLOB_SMIR, GCPSTORAGE_SMIR, GSUITE_MARKETPLACE, MSOFFICE365_MARKETPLACE, SLACK_MARKETPLACE, SALESFORCE_MARKETPLACE]

scanInfo
object
scanAction
int32
]
